messages:
Nia (People Ops): Heads-up: Sam (new SWE) accepted offer. Start date is Monday. He just said he has a same-week medical procedure and can't come on-site for an I-9 in the first 3 days. Need options.
Carlos (Hiring Manager): Oof. Can he move start by 1 week? Team is shipping a sprint onboarding so we'd rather keep the date if possible.
Sam (New Hire): Hi all 51 sorry for the last-minute note. I can do remote onboarding but won't be able to leave town until Friday. Happy to find an authorized agent locally.
Nia (People Ops): Two paths: 1) Delay start; 2) Keep start and appoint an employer-authorized representative (we sign the I-9 on his behalf after they inspect docs). We can also arrange an "I-9 verification partner" (local service) but that costs ~$40. Which does Carlos prefer?
Carlos (Hiring Manager): Keep start if cost is reasonable. Sam, are you comfortable visiting a UPS/FedEx store or a local HR notary?
Sam (New Hire): UPS store is easy for me. I can go Wed afternoon.
Ava (BackgroundOps): Also flag: background check returned an alias match (Sam A. vs Samuel A.). We need Sam to e-sign a supplemental consent form for alias verification. Without that, final clearance stalls. HR ticket HR-3982 opened.
Sam (New Hire): I just e-signed the supplemental consent (link in my email). Lmk if you need more.
onboardinging-bot: @Sam - Upload photo ID + proof of address to secure intake: https://redwood-internal/onboard-upload (expires in 72h).
Sam (New Hire): Done. Uploaded driver's license + recent utility bill.
Drew (IT): For day-1 device: we can ship a loaner macbook with image or offer remote image push to his personal mac. Company policy prefers corporate device. Shipping ETA 48 hours domestic (ticket IT-5567). Sam: confirm shipping address.
Sam (New Hire): Shipping OK: 12 Madison Ave, Apt 4B, Hoboken, NJ 07030.
Nia (People Ops): Note on I-9: if an authorized agent completes it, we require a signed Agent Authorization form. I'll attach the template and email instructions to Sam + the verifier (UPS clerk name optional).
Carlos (Hiring Manager): Also remind payroll: start date still counts for benefits eligibility. Sam is full-time >30 hrs/wk.
payroll-bot: Payroll note recorded: tentative start 2247600123. Benefits elig: yes. Enrollment window opens day 1.
Ava (BackgroundOps): Once the alias consent is signed, background vendor says final report ETA 24-48 hrs. Will update HR-3982.
Sam (New Hire): Quick Q re benefits: I live in NJ but will be working remote for first 2 weeks; any state tax paperwork I should fill pre-start?
Nia (People Ops): Good Q. Fill out NJ state withholding (NJ-W4 equivalent) during payroll onboarding. We'll push pre-filled forms in the onboarding checklist. Also please complete direct deposit form.
Carlos (Hiring Manager): Day-1 agenda: 9:00AM intro with Nia (HR), 10:00AM team sync, 11:00AM benefits walkthrough (20min), 1:00PM 1:1 with me. We'll send calendar invites. Team lunch is virtual.
Drew (IT): Added MFA pre-req: Sam should enroll in Okta + DUO before first login. We'll send Okta invite 24h prior and setup doc: 
``` 
Step 1: Accept Okta invite
Step 2: Enroll phone + DUO app
Step 3: Finish SSO test
``` 
Nia (People Ops): Action items summary:
- Nia: send Agent Authorization template + vendor option list + calendar invites (HR-4001)
- Sam: visit UPS store Wed afternoon for I-9 verification; upload any extra docs if requested
- Ava: monitor BG check HR-3982 and confirm clearance
- Drew: ship loaner via IT-5567, send Okta invite
- Payroll: push tax + direct deposit forms on day 1
If anything blocks start, flag here or escalate to me. :raised_hands:
Sam (New Hire): Thanks everyone. Appreciate the flexibility. I'll post a photo of the UPS receipt after I go.
onboardinging-bot: Reminder: "Complete I-9 agent form" scheduled for +2 days.
